subject: Follow-up: SOC 2 Type II docs & EvidenceHub access — next steps
messages:

Subject: Intro + security intake for evaluation

Hi Rishi / Aditya —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap from our side and the initial asks so we can move the evaluation forward:

- We need a copy of your latest SOC 2 Type II report (or redacted version) and an interim bridge letter if available.
- Our security team has a short vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) — I attached the sheet for context (Marchmont_VSQ.xlsx).
- GDPR question: we need assurance around EU data residency and whether we use EU-based processing or only US regions.
- HIPAA: confirm whether Redwood is willing to sign a BAA and whether there are any data flow limitations we should be aware of.

Can you outline a short timeline for documents and a secure place where we can retrieve them? We have a procurement window next week, so a 3–5 business day turnaround would be ideal.

Thanks,
Gina Park
Head of Vendor Risk
Marchmont Health
Attachments: Marchmont_VSQ.xlsx

Hi Gina —

Great talking earlier — appreciate the clear asks. Quick plan from our side:

1) SOC 2 artifacts: I have asked Lauren to provision a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and an interim bridge letter. We will upload both to our secure EvidenceHub link and share credentials.

2) VSQ: we reviewed the attached and will start populating answers. If you prefer, we can load our responses into your spreadsheet or send a completed PDF.

3) GDPR / data residency: Redwood can run in EU regions; I will include a short note from our infra team about region mapping and data flow.

4) HIPAA / BAA: Aditya is copied — he’ll coordinate our legal/BAA process and timeline.

Timeline: Lauren will upload SOC2 + bridge letter within 48 business hours; VSQ first-pass within 3 business days. Let me know if your procurement timeline shortens.

Link we will use: EvidenceHub (secure share) — https://evidencehub.redwood.ai/s/marchmont-4491

Talk soon,
Rishi

Thanks Rishi —

Perfect. We’ve also attached our formal VSQ in PDF (Vendor_VS_Q_20261118.pdf). A couple of priority items for the security reviewers:

- Confirmation of encryption at-rest for customer data and key management details.
- Clarify whether the redacted SOC 2 will include system boundaries for cloud/off-prem components.
- Please flag any areas in the VSQ where you need additional context from our team.

If you can get the interim bridge letter and SOC2 into EvidenceHub by end of day Friday that would keep us on track for procurement.

— Gina

Hi Gina —

Per Rishi’s note, I uploaded the requested artifacts to EvidenceHub and added a one-page summary for your reviewers. Files uploaded:
- SOC2_T2_2025-11-01.pdf (redacted)
- BridgeLetter_Interim_20261119.pdf
- Attachment: short FAQ on data residency and encryption (inline summary below).

EvidenceHub link (view-only, expires 7 days): https://evidencehub.redwood.ai/s/marchmont-4491
Access code: MARCH-4491-EB

Quick answers so your reviewers don’t have to dig:
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest; TLS1.3 in transit; customer keys supported via KMS/HSM integrations.
- Data residency: we operate in multiple cloud regions. For Marchmont we can restrict processing to EU regions for data marked as EU-resident; log and telemetry can be routed per contract.
- SOC 2 scope: covers our hosted inference runtime and control plane; PII processing and access controls are included. (See redacted scoping section in PDF.)

If your security team needs a deeper call with our infosec lead, happy to schedule.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Manager, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
